question: Does balanced visual instruction data help Chinese counting and spatial understanding in a matched continuation?

training.freeze: Projector and first/last LM layers trainable; vision and all other LM parameters frozen.
training.precision: BF16 autocast with FP32 master parameters
training.optimizer: AdamW fused, cosine to 10% start LR, gradient clip 1
training.comparison: Shared rendered image bytes, sample order and hyperparameters. The intervention changes supervision task and answer distribution jointly.

smoke.gate: Teacher-forced exact >=24/32, and supervised loss <=50% of initial loss.

eval.decode: FP32 greedy with shared deterministic prefix
eval.selection: Choose highest original-image base semantic accuracy on the frozen 80-item dev split. Break ties toward the shorter cap.
eval.swap: Identical question with its partner image whose gold differs; also score against the partner label.
eval.primary: Existing frozen natural-photo test (240), previously measured on the starting checkpoint.
eval.secondary: Fresh held-out transformed COCO challenge (240), with zero and 5+ counts, numerical comparison and three spatial axes.
eval.metrics: Semantic, normalized EM, short compliance, both images correct, image-condition differences, repetition, contradiction, and heuristic hallucination.
eval.text: 100 three-way Chinese fixed text probes through candidate mean log likelihood.
eval.bootstrap: 2000 paired draws over complete pairs, seed 1726.

gates.second_seed: Train seed 123 only if seed 42 passes all primary gates. Use the same selected decode cap.
